originalTitle: Meta's 'powerful breakout' sets up a unique trading strategy, says Mike Khouw
summary: With a brilliant hardware funnel and an options market pricing in juicy short-term premiums, Meta looks primed for a powerful breakout into 2027.
content:
Meta shares have become the market's muse, with its meteoric rise exhausting every superlative in the English vocabulary. Less talked about is what that surge has done for options prices.

Fueling this optimism was Meta's surprise release of a new consumer hardware product, the "Muse Charm," using the company's artificial intelligence, following the wildly successful launch of Muse, its AI agent. This hardware launch is a big move. After some of Meta's earlier hardware releases proved less than originally hoped, the Charm represents Meta's ambition to bypass the Apple-and-Google duopoly by offering a dedicated, keychain-sized device users can interact with anytime.

The surging stock has rippled through the options market as well. The Volatility Play: Currently, Meta's 1-month Implied Volatility (IV) is hovering at approximately 44%. This is about one standard deviation above its 37% mean over the past year, suggesting near-term option premiums are historically rich. To capitalize on this elevated volatility while maintaining a bullish long-term stance, traders can structure a unique strategy that collects time decay to finance a directional bet.

One highly efficient approach is deploying a near-dated short strangle , perhaps about a month out, such as the October 30th expiration. By writing an out-of-the-money call and an out-of-the-money put for late October, traders can harvest the elevated premium as time value rapidly decays.

You can then use the premium collected from that short strangle to help finance a longer-dated January long call. Even if the longer-dated call costs more than the nearer-dated options collect, the trade's carry can still be positive because short-dated options have more "theta" (decay). Ideally, you want Meta shares to stay between $700 and $900 by October expiration and then rally into the end of the year.

This structure effectively subsidizes your out-of-pocket cost for the January call, giving you leveraged, bullish exposure to Meta into the new year while letting near-term volatility crush work in your favor.

The Muse Charm wasn't the only hardware win at Connect. Meta's broader spatial computing and wearable strategy continues to accelerate. Alongside the Charm, the company introduced lighter-weight virtual reality goggles and new audio-only smart glasses, further solidifying its dominance in ambient computing.

Furthermore, Muse is already securing deep retail integrations, allowing the AI to seamlessly connect with giants like Walmart, Best Buy, and Gap. Meta is rapidly becoming the foundational layer for how consumers interact with agentic AI.

With a brilliant hardware funnel and an options market pricing in juicy short-term premiums, Meta looks primed for a powerful breakout into 2027.

chineseTitle: Mike Khouw 表示，Meta 的“强大突破”建立了独特的交易策略
chineseSummary: 凭借出色的硬件漏斗和期权市场定价丰厚的短期溢价，Meta 看起来已准备好在 2027 年实现强劲突破。
chineseContent:
Meta 股票已成为市场的缪斯，其飞速上涨耗尽了英语词汇中的所有最高级词汇。很少有人谈论的是这种飙升对期权价格的影响。

继推出人工智能代理 Muse 并取得巨大成功后，Meta 出人意料地发布了一款使用该公司人工智能的新消费硬件产品“Muse Charm”，这进一步助长了这种乐观情绪。这次硬件的发布是一个重大举措。在 Meta 早期发布的一些硬件被证明没有达到最初的预期之后，Charm 代表了 Meta 的雄心，即通过提供用户可以随时交互的专用、钥匙扣大小的设备来绕过苹果和谷歌双头垄断。

飙升的股票也波及了期权市场。波动性：目前，Meta 的 1 个月隐含波动性 (IV) 徘徊在 44% 左右。这比过去一年的平均值 37% 高出大约一个标准差，表明近期期权溢价处于历史最高水平。为了利用这种波动性的上升，同时保持看涨的长期立场，交易者可以构建一种独特的策略，收集时间衰减来为方向性押注提供资金。

一种高效的方法是部署近期的空头宽跨式期权，可能是一个月后的期权，例如 10 月 30 日到期的期权。通过在 10 月底卖出价外看涨期权和价外看跌期权，交易者可以在时间价值迅速衰减时收获较高的溢价。

然后，您可以使用从该空头跨式期权组合中收取的权利金来帮助为期限较长的一月多头看涨期权融资。即使长期看涨期权的成本高于近期期权的成本，交易的利差仍然可以为正，因为短期期权有更多的“theta”（衰减）。理想情况下，您希望 Meta 股价在 10 月份到期之前保持在 700 美元至 900 美元之间，然后反弹到年底。

这种结构有效地补贴了您一月份看涨期权的自付费用，为您在新的一年提供杠杆、看涨的 Meta 敞口，同时让近期的波动性压垮对您有利。

Muse Charm 并不是 Connect 上唯一获胜的硬件。 Meta 更广泛的空间计算和可穿戴战略继续加速。除了 Charm 之外，该公司还推出了重量更轻的虚拟现实护目镜和新型纯音频智能眼镜，进一步巩固了其在环境计算领域的主导地位。

此外，Muse 已经在确保深度零售集成，使人工智能能够与沃尔玛、百思买和 Gap 等巨头无缝连接。元正在迅速成为消费者与代理人工智能交互的基础层。

凭借出色的硬件漏斗和期权市场定价丰厚的短期溢价，Meta 看起来已准备好在 2027 年实现强劲突破。
